messages:
jordan-cust: Hey team — hitting inconsistent embedding dims from the embeddings endpoint. Our consumer expects 1536 but about 5% of requests return 1024, and a couple returned an empty array. Happening across Python and TS SDKs. request_id=rcpt_2026_04_09_3311 :frowning:

support-lee: Sorry about that — can you paste a minimal repro (SDK + config) and one of the failing request_ids? Also which SDK versions? :eyes:

jordan-cust: repro: batch 32 with text list, timeout=250ms, client retries enabled.
Python snippet:
```
from redwood import Embeddings
emb = Embeddings(api_key=KEY, timeout=0.25, retries=2)
res = emb.create(input=texts, model="open-embedding-1536", batch_size=32)
print(len(res.data[0].embedding))
```
failing id: rcpt_2026_04_09_3311
SDKs: python 0.11.2, ts 0.10.4

priya-eng: Noted. Any proxy/loadbalancer in front of you? Is this reproducible with smaller batches? Also please attach raw response body (if you saved it).

jordan-cust: No proxy. Smaller batches (<=4) look fine. Batches >16 see the issue more often. Attached log excerpt:
```
[2026-04-09T12:33:01Z] request rcpt_2026_04_09_3311 START batch_size=32
[2026-04-09T12:33:01Z] server: started worker w=12
[2026-04-09T12:33:01Z] server: partial response sent for rcpt_2026_04_09_3311 (2/32 embeddings)
[2026-04-09T12:33:02Z] sdk: timeout, retrying (1)
[2026-04-09T12:33:02Z] server: second partial response merged -> returned 3 embeddings total
```

sam-eng: That log is helpful. Looks like our runtime may send partial streaming chunks for very long batches; if the client treats a retried request as a fresh call and then merges streamed chunks incorrectly, you can end up with fewer embeddings or mixed sizes. @priya-eng did we recently change retry behavior in SDKs?

priya-eng: Yes — we introduced a generic retry wrapper in SDK v0.10+ which retries whole requests on timeout/errors. For streaming/async batching we didn't properly guard against partial-chunk re-assembly. Patch in progress. :hammer_and_wrench:

devx-ryan: Quick mitigation for customers: set environment variable to disable client retries for embeddings or reduce batch size. Examples:
- PY: set retries=0 or timeout>=2.0
- TS: client config { retries: 0, batch: { maxSize: 8 } }
- GO: export EMBED_SDK_RETRIES=0

support-lee: Also try setting batch_size=1 (expensive but confirms if batching is root cause). Jordan, can you try with retries=0 and batch_size=8 and report back?

jordan-cust: Will test now. Side question: any server-side ramp we need to wait for? We saw a deploy around when it started.

deploy-bot: deploy: inference-runtime v3.4.1 -> v3.4.2 rolled at 2026-04-09T12:00Z (inc:DEP-412). No known breaking changes to embedding payload shape.

priya-eng: The rollout shouldn't change dims but might affect streaming chunk timing. We're working a fix that changes SDK retry to cancel on partial-stream detection and re-request full batch or fallback to server-side non-stream path. Target patch: python/ts/go v0.11.0+ with a safe default of retries=0 for embeddings.

sam-eng: For reproducible test: run a local loop sending 1000 batched requests with batch_size=32 and short timeout (200-300ms) and client retries on. Collect request_ids where embedding count != input count. Script sketch:
```
for i in range(1000):
  id = send_batch(32, timeout=0.25, retries=2)
  if len(response.embeddings) != 32:
    print('BAD', id, len(response.embeddings))
```

priya-eng: Filed INC-7892, patch queued. Short-term plan: (1) disable retries on embedding calls by default in SDK patch, (2) add server-side guard to return 5xx instead of partial stream when worker is interrupted, (3) add metrics/dashboards to catch dim mismatch spikes.

support-lee: Jordan — want me to enable a temporary server-side flag to force full responses (no streaming) for your org so you can validate without changing client config?

jordan-cust: That would be great. If you can flip it for org_id:org_998, we can run the test this afternoon.

priya-eng: Done — server flag enabled for org_998 at 2026-04-09T13:05Z. Also left a note in INC-7892. :white_check_mark:

jordan-cust: After setting retries=0 and batch_size=8 I ran 500 requests — no mismatches so far. Thanks! Will wait for SDK patch but this is a workable temp fix.

support-lee: Excellent. We'll keep INC-7892 open and ping when the SDK patch is published. PR refs will be posted in the ticket.

jordan-cust: Thanks all. Appreciate the quick triage. "If you need log dumps or more traces, shout." :raised_hands: "Will test once patch lands."
